0022600216.text: The Trail Blazers host the Oklahoma City Thunder in their 10th game of the season, with Portland at 6-3 and eighth in the West, 1.5 games behind the Northwest leaders in third place in its division, while it has lost two straight and is 1-2 at home. Oklahoma City, first in the West and the Northwest at 8-2, enters on a four-game winning streak and is 5-0 at home. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Robert Williams III is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber. The teams have not played this season yet, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost 1-3 in their season series, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31.
